acceptanceCriteria: Container validation and toolIdentity derive the Go version from one constant; a test proves a go1.27.2 container result validates and a mismatched one refuses.
body: Found by the ci-shadow-historical-compat lane (branch claude/ci-shadow-historical-compat, d41c810d2). tools/corvint-pr-tests run_result.go container validation requires id.GoVersion == "go1.27.0" while toolIdentity requires go1.27.2, so no container result can pass both. Expected: one source of truth for the pinned Go version.
title: corvint-pr-tests: container run results can never validate (run_result.go requires GoVersion go1.27.0, toolIdentity requires go1.27.2)
